Sterlet Caviar
Sterlet caviar is a historically esteemed variety of true sturgeon caviar sourced exclusively from the Sterlet sturgeon Acipenser ruthenus. Revered for centuries across Russia Austria and Iran this caviar was once considered a royal delicacy reserved for imperial courts and nobility.
Known for its refinement rather than intensity Sterlet caviar offers a delicate and elegant flavor profile. The taste is mild and clean with subtle buttery nuances and a soft creamy finish that melts seamlessly on the palate. Its understated character makes it one of the most sophisticated expressions of traditional sturgeon caviar.
The pearls are notably small and uniform ranging in color from silvery grey to soft ash tones reflecting its classic heritage. Due to the Sterlet sturgeon’s smaller size and lower roe yield this caviar remains relatively rare enhancing its exclusivity and luxury appeal.
Processed using a carefully controlled traditional salting and maturation method Sterlet caviar preserves purity texture and flavor resulting in a refined timeless product prized by purists and connoisseurs alike.
Species Details
Acipenser ruthenus
Common Name Sterlet Sturgeon
Maturity 6 to 8 plus years
Average Weight 5 to 7kg
Color Silver grey to light ash
Roe Size Small fine pearls
Flavor Profile Mild buttery refined
